name: Achelir

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that does minor flame damage.

abilities.name: Heat Wave
abilities.description: The enemy releases fire along the ground in the direction it is facing. This attack does moderate flame damage to all players hit by it. This spell can be interrupted to set the enemy off balance or simply avoided.

abilities.name: Fire Runes
abilities.description: The enemy shoots two fireballs in the air which form two fire runes when they land. The runes do moderate flame damage over time to all enemies within the red circles and should be avoided. Players should be prepared to move as soon as the attack casts as one rune will always be cast on top of you.

abilities.name: Ring of Fire
abilities.description: Achelir summons a ring of fire around himself that lingers for a long duration, causing continuous moderate flame damage.
